analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md, at head lines 2966-2970 (base 2966). It adds a sentence saying the cluster service's automatic re-plan and re-adoption after a worker-digest update waits until both Macs report the same worker build (`ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild`). It also links to the pair's coordinated update and notes that a plan made while the Macs run different builds would fail and wait 600 s. No code, configuration, authorization, attestation, encryption or data-handling behavior changes in this diff. I found no regression against the supplied threat model (T-041 prefix cache, TB-002, TB-003, TB-007 or the attestation entries). The new text describes a gating condition on cluster re-planning. The claim relies on code outside this batch (`ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild`, `ClusterService.checkForUpdate`) and on the linked page `../provider/cluster-always-on.md`. I did not verify either, so the doc could drift from the code. Taken as stated, the condition is availability-oriented and would reduce failed or mismatched-build planning. Any related code change in the PR would still need to confirm that the oneBuild check does not trust a peer-reported digest in a way that skips worker-digest binding. The rest of the base text in the supplied units (MiMo, Qwen4, cluster stages, invariants) is unchanged context, and I found no pre-existing issues that this PR makes worse.
